body: Just to be clear for **future readers** (or ourselves in several months), changing the CSP to accept the `eval` would mean adding `unsafe-eval`. In most cases, the common security recommendation is to avoid eval() at all costs, as it can be a vector for Cross-Site Scripting attacks (if you want to know more, learn about [the `script-src` directive](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Content-Security-Policy/script-src) in a Content Security Policy).
